name: switch-surface
title: The switches the documents name, against the ones the parser accepts
description: The command surface was audited in the two previous rounds; the switch surface has not been. The help names a dozen flags and the READMEs name a few more, including per-command ones like --scope and --args. Extract them and hold each against what the parser actually accepts, in both the argparse definitions and the manual prefix handling
creator: aixi
